title: Animated Lights
description: Adds cool animations or slight flickers to most light sources.
body:
Adds cool animations or slight flickers to most light sources. And flames for the torch cause it doesn't look good without it.

**If it says broken or incompatible, ignore it.**

Animations include: _Torch, Soul Torch, Copper Torch, Lantern, Soul Lantern, Copper Lantern (and oxidization variants), Glowstone, Shroomlight, Redstone Lamp, Copper Bulb (and oxidization variants), Furnace._
